steps.content: █ In the aftermath of the "Crimson Obsequies", the repercussions of the cabinet attack continue to escalate. Despite efforts to regulate the dissemination of information, the rise in independent media engagement has considerably complicated the management of public opinion.

█ Analysis of the Underground Puppets collected from the scene suggests the orchestrators of both incidents are likely one single Underground group. This marks the Underground's first large-scale overt attack against Eastside's elite in years, indicating their target scope extends beyond the Stewart family.
█ Evidently, this is just the beginning. With the FAC unusually facing numerous restrictions during the election season, the situation risks further deterioration...

November 30, N.F. 114
Election Season Assaults
Joint Investigation Team
In a secure conference room, three people sit with thick stacks of documents before them.
The first person to finish sets down the report and starts drumming her fingers on the table, tap after tap.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: What a show. The Underground sure knows how to spice up the Election.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: I heard some FAC folks were at the scene. Seems like a touchy subject. Those old foxes giving you trouble?
She looks up at the veteran soldier across the table.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Me? What for? It's just two retired soldiers who left the service over a decade ago, working for their new employers. That's what any investigation will show.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Better be careful. They've got their eyes on you more than they do on the Underground these days.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Doesn't matter. We're not here for small talk, are we? Let's get to business.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: You've been to EDGE, then why didn't you request to postpone the election?

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: After what has happened, voters across the city are in an agitated state. With in-person voting, polling stations will be jam-packed on election day. If the Underground decides to make any move, the consequences would be catastrophic.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Consequences? They're more afraid of what a delay would bring. It's our beacon's big show that happens once every four years. The world's watching this. If DisCity displays even a hint of vulnerability, the vultures will start circling.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Looks like we'll have to put in some overtime and catch our enemy quickly. So, Chief, how's the investigation shaping up?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: I heard you lucked out and got a front-row seat for the second assault. What did you see?
Both leaders of the FAC and the 9th Agency turn their gazes toward the third person in the room—you, who has remained silent since entering.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: ...Feeling nervous about having your first meeting with your old boss?

options: Indeed, please be gentle with me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There are many factors at play in these cases. I'm still trying to piece things together.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Is it related to the Underground's dark web and the new Puppet model? Right, those investigations do tend to eat up time.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, the investigation on those Mania-related cases is still in process, but there's more to it than that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'd also like to approach it from another way, to see who might have the motive to exterminate David Stewart and all his families.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: You're saying, there's someone else.
You nod.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Underground has always been discreet, pulling strings behind the scenes. Both the dark web and the Garden served as their tools, and they've gone to great lengths to leave no trace when triggering the Black Rings. This time, however, they're acting with no scruples.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, given that the Stewart cabinet was never interested in controlling Mania, they should've posed no apparent threat to the Underground. But even so, they were murdered in such a brutal way...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, as the heads of three anti-Mania departments, if we're still alive and kicking here, we must be terrible at our jobs. Apparently, the Underground thinks we’re less of a concern than the little Stewart girl.
Langley lets out a laugh while the commander remains expressionless.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Go on.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've heard that Stewart was quite radical in city matters. He probably made some formidable enemies, stood in someone's way, or learned things over the years that weren't meant to be known.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The stress of running for re-election could be taking its toll on him, leading to some erratic behavior. It's possible that someone viewed him as a threat and wanted him dead, with his daughter being targeted for the same reason.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They might've gained damaging information on someone, or the assailant just believes they know something.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It could be the Underground, or people who have dealings with them.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: So, you think the Underground has weaseled their way into the top brass, and now you're playing detective all on your own?
...Sensing a shift in the atmosphere, you collect yourself and carefully consider how to address her pointed question.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes, you tasked me with uncovering the truth, so I've been investigating those I find suspicious and have obtained some intelligence—
[Flashback: Banquet Scene]
[MK's portrait]

Max King, a notable personality in Eastside, having worn many hats—judge, musician, writer, explorer, and businessman. However, he is most recognized as a leading social media influencer, with his account "MK" commanding a massive following across all platforms.

After the Square Black Ring incident, he decided to redirect his business endeavors towards the West District. His subsequent declaration to enter the election race has garnered even greater public interest.
[Vale]

Adrian Vale, serving in the FAC until N.F. 103, after which he roamed within Syndicate before dropping off the grid for a period. Rumor has it that he met Max King during his lowest point, eventually becoming his assistant and butler.

As per Vale's service record, he participated in numerous pivotal operations throughout his service, garnering considerable merits and earning high esteem from his superiors. Notably, S9 was also a former FAC soldier who was discharged in N.F. 103.
Unlike Adrian Vale, S9 chose to stay in Eastside afterwards, taking up covert security work for the city's upper class.
For veterans like them, working as private security for influential figures is indeed a decent career path.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: I know some candidates are in a desperate situation. They might try to use you for their own ends.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Be careful, Chief. Steer clear of those politicians.
These words remind you of a recent memory—

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Hey, no sweat! Fighting alongside you totally made this scratch worthwhile! I definitely got the better end of the deal!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: We might not have much time together today, but one day, you'll see who I really am. For now, just remember one thing—

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Your actions have ignited a fire in many hearts. In the near future, they will all stand with you as allies.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: You think I have ulterior motives? That I'm seizing this chance to approach you, rope you in, and earn your trust to vote for me? That would be undignified, and unnecessary.

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Since you don't have a liking for politicians like me, I won't trouble you beyond today. This is just a one-time personal request—to protect a child who has recently lost her loved one.
Both of them have approached you. Whatever they say, you've probably already been used as their pawn—not that it matters.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: All this information is provided directly by those in the incidents and can be easily verified.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But whenever I try to delve into the death records of the cabinet attack or the guest list from the memorial service...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I keep being told that these VIPs and Eastside bigshots have special privacy privileges, and that I have no authority to inquire into their affairs.
As you say this, you shift your gaze towards Langley, who returns it with a smile.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Because investigating them is the 9th Agency's turf.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: May I ask if you've found anything?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: No one has been confirmed to be involved so far. They're all too caught up in the election frenzy.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Oh, totally slipped my mind. She's the one who gave you the invite, isn't she? Don't worry, she's well aware she's under a spotlight. She'll play nice.
Her deliberately vague response makes it hard to verify whether they are truly "old acquaintances," as Bernadette Cavendish claimed, and even harder to discern her true intentions in approaching you.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Look, the 9th Agency holds the reins when it comes to probing these VIPs because our agents know their boundaries—skilled enough to gather intel, and discreet enough to keep secrets.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: So save your breath trying to squeeze info out of me. After all, don't you already have your own little inside track?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: The Stewarts are still hounding me about finding his missing niece, but strangely, I don't see any mention of this in your report.
Clearly, this inquiry is not a casual one. She's waiting for your answer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: DNA tests have verified that the girl is indeed David Stewart's daughter. But she has no public records, and her mental state has consistently been unstable.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She has experienced significant suffering both before and after the attack. The trauma has led to a high fever, making her unable to communicate for now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Jelena was hired by then-Councilor Stewart in N.F. 107 and has been Elvira's caretaker for seven years. Prior to this role, she held positions at several educational institutions. Mania testing has verified her as an A-Class Sinner with a Catalyst Tendency.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At the time of the cabinet assault, both she and Elvira were at David Stewart's private residence and did not leave.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: According to FAC records, Sable wasn't regularly discharged but rather dismissed from the FAC due to inadequate performance during an operation. After that, she was immediately recruited by Councilor Stewart.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since N.F. 103, Sable has served as Elvira's personal bodyguard.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: That's all they told you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. It seems the late Prime Minister didn't place as much trust in them as one might assume. These three were kept hidden away because he saw them as nothing but stains on his reputation.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: That's just their side of the story. Chief, if you're too nice to grill them, how about bringing them over to the 9th Agency?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: I could give you a crash course in interrogation tactics.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Please, do not hand us over to any other forces—be it the Stewart family, the 9th Agency, or the FAC. Don't let any of them come at her again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...That won't be necessary. I have my own ways of getting to the truth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's also a name list that might interest you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They agreed to stay under my care, with certain conditions. I'll take full responsibility for my Sinners.
Langley takes the document from you, quickly scans it, and breaks into a smile.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Alright, chill out, I was just pulling your leg. Let them stay with you. It suits me just fine—might even be more effective with you at the helm.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: I'm out. Got a long queue outside my interrogation room waiting for me.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Keep your witnesses well-protected, Chief. Many folks seemed jittery about that secret daughter's existence during my interrogations. That speaks volumes about her value.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Don't let her fall into anyone else's hands, and make sure she stays breathing.
After delivering her final words, she leaves promptly, likely with a multitude of tasks awaiting her attention.
As the meeting draws to a close, the FAC Commander-in-Chief also rises from his seat.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: FAC's main forces will be deployed to the DisSea frontline during the upcoming election month. Urban security will be jointly managed by MBCC and the Public Security Bureau.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Your adjutant has received all relevant data and permissions. Contact me if anything comes up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Commander, a moment please.
The Commander halts in his tracks, turning around to face you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There are still many questions about the attackers, and I need more information on the crime scene. I've heard about an incident within the FAC base yesterday—does it have anything to do with the cases? May I request an investigation?
The Commander's expression remains unchanged, but you can't shake the feeling of his prosthetic eye scrutinizing you.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: ...It's just some malfunctioning old equipment. No cause for alarm. FAC will take care of this.
You find the response far from satisfactory. You carefully weigh your words before finally speaking up again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...These incidents aren't just the Underground's doing—there are multiple layers of mystery at play here. Moreover, with the FAC forces receiving an unusual deployment order... Commander, could someone higher up be trying to—

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: FAC will handle it. There's no need for concern.
Perhaps realizing his response might sound too harsh, he pauses for a moment before speaking again.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: Chief, you do have sharp instincts, but be careful not to let them lead you astray—especially in the shadows, where you can easily lose your way.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: These are sensitive times. Focus on your duties, and stay true to yourself. This is the only advice I can give you—protect yourself.

steps.speaker: FAC Commander
steps.content: And the citizens—their safety is in your hands now.
[Scene Change] Inside a vehicle
As you head back to the Bureau, you reflect on those words.
The investigation team maintains neutrality, just like your three agencies do. It's precisely because none of you have direct obligations to any faction that you were entrusted with this task.
But there's no doubt about it—you've sensed an enormous shadow looming over you. And now, more so than during any previous Mania crisis, you're closer than ever to the root of this darkness.

The 9th Agency, safeguarding secrets for <color=#fb9259>certain people</color>; FAC, deeply feared by <color=#fb9259>certain people</color>; and then there's MBCC and yourself, their definition of your roles still veiled... This case resembles a key, guiding you further into DisCity's depths, towards yet another shrouded mystery.
Engrossed in these thoughts, you suddenly realize the car hasn't moved for quite some time.

steps.speaker: Driver
steps.content: No, Chief. We're... stuck here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What...? Agh!
Before you can react, multiple hands suddenly start slamming against the window beside your ear.

steps.speaker: Reporter A
steps.content: Chief! It's the MBCC Chief!!! Stop him—!!
steps.female_content: Chief! It's the MBCC Chief!!! Stop her—!!

steps.speaker: Reporter A
steps.content: Is it true that you attended the Stewarts' memorial service? Why did they invite you? There's something fishy going on with Prime Minister's death, right?

steps.speaker: Reporter B
steps.content: You allied with Max King, does it mean that the West District is now backing the MK Group? What does your boss say about your decision? Has the West District turned its back on the Cavendish family? Has Miss Matilda Cavendish officially broken ties with her family?

steps.speaker: Rowdy Crowd
steps.content: Are you also joining the fray? As a West District rep or on your own? What are your campaign strategies, and do your supporters align with your stance?

steps.speaker: Rowdy Crowd
steps.content: Chief! Chief!! Over here! This way!!
The door is violently wrenched open, and the crowd surges towards you like a horde of Corruptors.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ugh... Please calm down!! This is classified information. I can't talk about it. I won't—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What is going on here?!
